hook: Rest salmon in the back pools piling up Stamps, then send them home to pour their stats into a neighbour.
loop: Each turn, park fish in the back pools or step them forward.
Survived attacks earn Stamps; full front-row passports come Home and Spawn.
Spent fish feed neighbours; Bradán, Kype or the Grandfather cash out big.

growth.line: Each homecoming spreads permanent stats; hoarded Stamps only climb, so late in-fight Attack gets huge.

feel.early: Thin: Grilse and Parr teach the loop, little buffing.
feel.mid: Bailiff stamps everyone; Hen and Bend-Wife grow the board.
feel.late: Bradán fires every Spawn; Llyn Llyw turns Stamps to Attack.

stars.why: Hold a fish for turns, then send it home: board-wide cash-out.
Fires every Spawn on the board, then resets instead of dying.
Doubles the Spawn of whichever fish comes home next to him.

card_short.u01: Home 3. Spawn: other Run units gain a Stamp.
card_short.u02: Home 1. Spawn: other Run units get +1/+1.
card_short.u03: Thrice a turn, a newly Stamped fish gains +1/+1.
card_short.u04: Neighbours earn a Stamp per attack, even if they die.
card_short.u06: Stamps all fish each turn; every third, eats the smallest.
card_short.u07: Gives another unit a passport and Home 3, no Spawn.
card_short.u08: Fish with matching Stamp counts gain +1/+1 each turn.
card_short.u09: Gains Attack per Stamp held; strikes at Start of Combat.
card_short.u10: Home 3. Spawn buffs fish, growing each time; survives twice.
card_short.u11: Repeats Spawn of fish coming home next to him.
card_short.u12: Home numbers 1 lower for your other fish.
card_short.u13: Each Stamp buffs three random units; Home 5 buffs all.
card_short.u14: Once a turn, copies a spent fish into your hand.
card_short.u15: Each time another fish Spawns, all fish gain +2/+2.
card_short.u16: Surviving attackers get +3/+3 this fight; back-row ones get Stamps.
card_short.u17: Home 5. Spawn: fires every other fish's Spawn, then resets.
card_short.u18: All units gain Attack per Stamp; back-row fish Stamp faster.
card_short.u19: Spent fish give all units +1/+1 per Stamp held.
card_short.x01: Shielded 1/1 left after a homecoming; regrows into the fish.

builds.name: The Spawning Run
builds.line: Something comes home each turn next to Jack; Bradán fires everything.

builds.name: The Long Road
builds.line: Back row hoards Stamps; Kype and Llyn Llyw cash them as Attack.

builds.name: Forest Feed
builds.line: Spent fish pour stats into another tribe's carry, like an Ooze.

liked: Hold in the back or step forward to spawn: a real choice every turn.
All three singled out the Grandfather's planned cash-out of hoarded Stamps.
worries: Llyn Llyw and Kype scale off Stamps that never drop; late fights swing huge.
Old Kelt's free copies make triples very fast, even of other tribes' units.
changed: Each slot comes home once a turn, so homecoming chains can't loop forever.
Fry now has Shield and hatches with no Stamps, softening the tempo hole.
Reunion Secretary is now one simple line; Veteran stamps back-row fish.
verdict: Rated 7.3 fun, 7.0 distinct and ranked first of three salmon designs; for players who love positioning and chain payoffs.
